samples.title: Security Lead
samples.description:
Keeping users money and data safe is the job. As our Security Lead, you take end-to-end responsibility for security at bunq. You will be the architect of that new way of working, and you will build it hands-on, together with a team of 3 security engineers.

samples.title: AML Manager, Austria
samples.description:
At bunq, we’re more than a bank. We’re on a mission to make banking work for people wherever they live in Europe. With local IBANs, our users can pay rent, sign up for the gym and get paid like a local from day one. Every successful transaction is a step toward making them feel at home and letting us truly “Make Life Easy.”
